title: Baton Rouge players and friends in New Orleans
summary: He names Toot Johnson's band, Johnny Handley, Joe Robichaux, George Lewis and George Guesnon.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Anybody up Baton Rouge, Wade, did you ever work up there much, Alexandria?

Well, I knew a few people around Baton Rouge. They used to have one of the good bands out of Baton Rouge. They called Toot Johnson. Yeah. Well, I remember Guy Kelly, he was from Baton Rouge, and also Johnny Handley. He's a clarinet player. He used to be around Baton Rouge. He used to be with Toot Johnson, but I think his home was up around past Christiane and Gruffville. He should be, still be around in Orleans. Johnny Handley. Clarinet player.
Oh yes, that's right, sure. Yeah. Yeah, he is there. He plays street bands all the time. Yeah. In the parades.
And I know Joe Robichaud, he and I are good friends.
Yeah, he was up here, he'll be here in two weeks and uh...
Yeah. Also, George Lewis, he and I are good friends.
George Gano. George Gano, that's my buddy.
Yeah, he used to wake me up there. Where did he work with you?
He worked all over with me.
We, you know, we had a traveling band. We had quite a jackson. He played all around with me.
Yeah. Well, I won't keep you any...
